sharedFacts: Fish tacos are the signature item. Vary what you call them — 'the fish tacos', 'our famous fish tacos', 'the El Pueblo Fish Taco' — never repeat the same phrasing twice in a row, and avoid the stiff menu name 'The Original Battered Fish Taco'.
Carne asada fries (also veggie, shrimp, surf & turf fries)
Quesadillas (carne asada, shrimp, adobada, carnitas and more)
Carnitas — tacos, burritos, tortas or plates
Menudo on Saturdays and Sundays only
Self-serve salsa bar — a condiment station with salsas and pickled vegetables. It is NOT seating and NOT a place to sit.
Free on-site parking lot at every location
